QA Engineer – Example Software AB

About us
We build software for the logistics industry in Stockholm.

Responsibilities
- Design and execute test plans
- Build and maintain automated tests

Requirements
- Experience with Playwright or Selenium
- API testing with Postman
- Knowledge of CI/CD and GitHub Actions
- Test strategy and regression testing
- Experience with performance testing, JMeter or k6
- Agile and Scrum, Jira
- Python or Java

Nice to have
- ISTQB certification
- Docker

We offer
A friendly team and flexible hours.
